name: nexafit
description: NexaFit — The next generation of fitness tracking. A premium, dark-mode fitness companion for runners and athletes.

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init NexaFit com.nexafit.app --web-dir www
scripts.cap:build:android: npx cap sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:build:ios: npx cap sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:www: mkdir -p www && copy index.html www\ && copy style.css www\ && copy script.js www\ && xcopy /E /I /Y assets www\assets\ && xcopy /E /I /Y js www\js\
scripts.deploy:android: npm run build:www && npx cap sync && npx cap open android
scripts.deploy:ios: npm run build:www && npx cap sync && npx cap open ios

author: NexaFit
